merge_request.title: Show alert when overrides list is hidden due to unset flat cap
merge_request.description:
<!--

## What does this MR do and why?

The MR does two things when no User caps was set on a subscription before:

- adds an info alert

- displays the flat cap value input empty

## References

- Follow-up on https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/628337#note_3811636720 thread
- Part of https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/596232

## How to set up and validate locally

The easiest way is to verify this through Storybook:

1. `yarn storybook:start`
2. Open http://localhost:6006/?path=/story/ee-usage-quotas-wallet-agnostic-credits-dashboard-credit-caps-app--null-cap story
3. Ensure that the fields are empty, and alert is displayed

The e2e way:

1. SM or SaaS instance with a paid license, where no caps were set previously
1. Open the GitLab Credits page (Admin area or settings area)
1. To the right of the header click "Credit caps"
    - SM: http://localhost:3000/admin/gitlab_credits_dashboard/credit_caps
    - SaaS: http://localhost:3000/groups/gitlab-org/-/settings/gitlab_credits_dashboard/credit_caps
1. On the Credit caps page verify that the input is empty, the status toggle is off, and there's the info alert
2. Set the Flat cap and save it
3. Verify that the alert is hidden and overrides list shows up
4. Reload the page, ensure that the Flat cap is preserved

**note:** this page is behind a `credit_caps_ui` Feature flag, but that flag is [currently default-enabled](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/255003)
